diff --git a/tests/test_testclient.py b/tests/test_testclient.py
index b5a347c..bfdd43f 100644
--- a/tests/test_testclient.py
+++ b/tests/test_testclient.py
@@ -32,6 +32,27 @@ def mock_service_endpoint(request: Request) -> JSONResponse:
 mock_service = Starlette(routes=[Route("/", endpoint=mock_service_endpoint)])
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "debug_info",
+    [
+        {"custom": "value", "details": {"answer": 42}},
+        {"template": "template", "context": {"request": "request"}, "custom": "value"},
+    ],
+)
+def test_http_response_debug(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory, debug_info: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        await send({"type": "http.response.debug", "info": debug_info})
+        await send({"type": "http.response.start", "status": 200, "headers": []})
+        await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": b""})
+
+    response = test_client_factory(app).get("/")
+
+    assert response.extensions["http.response.debug"] == debug_info
+    if "template" in debug_info:
+        assert response.template == debug_info["template"]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        assert response.context == debug_info["context"]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+
+
 def current_task() -> Task[Any] | trio.lowlevel.Task:
     # anyio's TaskInfo comparisons are invalid after their associated native
